label: Protein Stability Prediction (stabiliNNator)
description: Predict protein stability improvements using Graph Neural Networks. proliNNator predicts proline mutation probabilities at each residue position, while disulfiNNate predicts disulfide bond formation likelihood between cysteine pairs. Both analyses output PDB files with probabilities encoded in the B-factor column (0-1 range).

parameters.label: Input Structure File
parameters.desc: Protein structure file in PDB or mmCIF format. The structure must contain standard amino acids with CA atoms.

parameters.label: Analysis Type
parameters.desc: Type of stability analysis to perform. 'proline' predicts favorable proline mutation sites, 'disulfide' predicts favorable disulfide bond sites, 'both' runs both analyses.

parameters.label: Hidden Dimension
parameters.desc: Hidden dimension size for the neural network. Default is 32 (both models were trained with hidden_dim=32). Only modify if using custom-trained models.

parameters.label: Compute Device
parameters.desc: Hardware accelerator to use. CPU is recommended (faster than GPU for these small models due to CUDA overhead). GPU option available but provides no performance benefit.

parameters.label: Report Theme
parameters.desc: Visual theme for the generated HTML report. 'bvbrc' matches the BV-BRC portal styling (default); 'editorial' is an alternative editorial layout.

parameters.label: Output Folder
parameters.desc: Workspace folder where prediction results will be saved. Output includes annotated PDB files with probabilities in the B-factor column.

parameters.label: Dry Run
parameters.desc: Download and prepare all input data but do not execute predictions. Useful for testing workspace file access and data preparation.

parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.desc: Job output name. Results land at ${output_path}/.${output_file}/ in the workspace.
